fact: The FinScope Angola 2022 consumer survey, commissioned by the Banco Nacional de Angola, finds 36% of adults hold a transactional account, a bank account or mobile payments.
AFI reports that Angola's minister said only 31% of the country's population has bank accounts.
Diario dos Negocios, citing the BNA's 2024 report, says 31.54% of the population had at least one bank account in 2024.
